en: The postcard consists of two sides. The front displays a colorized image of a grand public park with lush greenery, fountains, and striking 19th-century buildings in the background. The park has a formal garden layout and the architecture appears ornate and detailed, typical of late 19th-century Nordic urban landscapes. Text at the bottom identifies this as 'Parken Vängåfvan' in Sundsvall, with a handwritten note in Swedish. The reverse side contains the printed word 'BREVKORT' along with 'CARTE POSTALE', and handwritten address details, a Swedish postal stamp, and further form text in Swedish.
